subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is option 1) i.e. 'at'. 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The context of the sentence is** Mahatma Gandhi was born at Porbandar.**
 
• According to the above-mentioned points, the most preposition to fill the blank is ‘at'.
 
• Use of 'at'- used to denote a particular place, time or activity.
 
• Another example:
 
 
• ​*Jeetu is very good **at **acting.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option 1.

 

Correct Sentence:__ *...**to Karamchand and Putlibai __**at**__ Porbandar...*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Let's look at the use of other options: 

 
 

 Preposition
 Usage
 
 
 
 

 through
 to denote from one end or side of something to the other; or from the beginning to the end of a period of time; or as a result of something
 
 

 above
 used to indicate something higher than something else; to indicate something higher in amount, or to indicate writings in an earlier part
 
 

 below
 
 
used to indicate something in a lower position; something less than a certain number; to indicate something written in a lower piece of writing
